option.name: -b
tip: Print the blocks reserved as bad in the file system.

option.name: -f
tip: Force display even when feature flags are not understood.

option.name: -g
tip: Display group descriptor information in machine-readable form.

option.name: -i
tip: Display file system data from an e2image image file.

option.name: -m
tip: Check whether the file system is in use by another node.

option.name: -o
tip: Use the given superblock or block size when examining the file system.

option.name: -V
tip: Print the version number and exit.

option.name: -x
tip: Print detailed group block numbers in hexadecimal.
